questions: Did the swelling or redness begin suddenly, within minutes to a few hours?
Are you having any difficulty breathing, swallowing, or speaking?
Does your throat feel tight, or do you feel that your tongue or lips are swelling?
Do you feel faint, dizzy, or unusually weak?
Do you have widespread itchy hives or an itchy rash elsewhere on your body?
Is the facial swelling getting worse right now?
Do you have a fever?
Is the affected skin unusually warm or painful?
Is the swelling mainly on one side of your face?
Do you have severe pain around either eye?
Is your vision blurred, doubled, or reduced?
Does it hurt when you move your eyes?
Do you have a severe headache, vomiting, confusion, or neck stiffness?
Did you recently have a dental problem, toothache, or dental treatment?
Did you recently have a sinus infection, sore throat, ear infection, or skin infection?
Did you recently injure your face or undergo a facial procedure or injection?
Did you recently start a new medication, including an antibiotic or painkiller?
Did you recently eat a new food or take a new supplement?
Did you recently use a new cosmetic, cream, cleanser, hair product, or facial treatment?
Did an insect or animal bite or sting your face recently?
Have you had a similar episode of facial swelling or redness before?
Do you have a history of allergies, asthma, eczema, or angioedema?
Are you taking an ACE-inhibitor blood-pressure medication such as enalapril, lisinopril, or ramipril?
Is one side of your face weak or drooping?
Are you having trouble closing either eye?
Do you have numbness or weakness in an arm or leg?
Do you have difficulty speaking or understanding speech?
Did the redness or swelling start after prolonged sun or heat exposure?
Have you recently had unusual sweating, flushing, palpitations, or diarrhea?
Are you currently pregnant or recently postpartum?
